title: Shell Game Fakeout Reveal
name: shell_game_fakeout_reveal
description: Three identical opaque cups stand on a table; a ball is shown under one cup before it lowers. The cups slide through two position swaps. First one cup (not covering the ball) lifts to show it is EMPTY; then the cup actually covering the ball lifts to reveal the ball inside - it stayed with its cup through the swaps.
